definitions.reduction_percent: 100*(1-P_M/P_B); reuse frozen native Bottom absolute peaks kN; P_B is baseline, P_M is modal-damping reference
definitions.story_axis_summary: 7 directional cases per axis; minimum, median and maximum with actual matching case and both absolute peaks; median is middle of 7 sorted actual observations
definitions.case_minimum: minimum over 12 layers; ties within 1e-10 percentage points all retained
definitions.mean_baseline: unweighted arithmetic mean of 12 layer reduction percentages; not a total-building force reduction
definitions.baseline_omission_gap: baseline reduction minus actual least layer reduction, percentage points; descriptive contrast, no pass/fail threshold
definitions.recurrence: report directional-case counts and deduplicated wave-family counts separately
definitions.groups: common RH4/SHW4/SHW7 X/Y six cases versus remaining R1/SHW3/SHW5/SHW6 X/Y eight; no holdout or independent-test designation

exclude: no fitting, native arrays, new ODE, spectral/modal decomposition, actual-device causal comparison or formal candidate algorithm
